verification_rules.identity: same subject identity as identity reference
verification_rules.style: same artistic style as style reference
verification_rules.quality: image should be coherent, detailed, sharp, and visually polished
verification_rules.aesthetic: image should have strong composition, lighting, color harmony, and professional finish
verification_rules.prompt_alignment: image should faithfully satisfy the initial user prompt and expanded visual brief

default_quality_profile: clear primary subject and readable scene composition
specific camera framing and focal length cues
avoid text, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, and low-resolution artifacts

vague_prompt: resolve vague intent into a concrete subject, setting, style, composition, lighting, color palette, and quality bar
preserve the user intent instead of changing the requested scene
multi_reference: preserve declared reference roles and keep identity/style/layout bindings explicit
